**LLMs can produce long-form outputs that are preferred to a large share of human long-form outputs.**

There are many fewer results on AI performance on long-form output, because these typically require humans to judge quality and so these are much more costly to collect data on. A few studies show that frontier LLMs perform well, but not at peak human level.

- https://openai.com/index/o3-mini-system-card/ can perform better than many humans on writing poems.

- https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-025-02194-6.pdf in multiround debates GPT-4 was found to be more persuasive than humans in making simple arguments (eg. on questions such as 'Should students have to wear school uniforms?').
